items.passage: Transcript: Hi, theatre club, it's Hana Okonkwo, this year's director. Auditions for the spring musical will all be in Room 417, and chorus auditions are on Friday at four. I'd originally planned to see everyone that afternoon, but anyone trying out for a lead role will now audition on Saturday at seven thirty instead, so I can give each of you a longer slot. Now, about audition material. In past years you'd pick up a printed packet from the club office. This time it's different. If you're going for the chorus, learn the song from the recording on the club's website. If you're going for a lead, you'll be emailed two short scenes on Wednesday, and you'll read one of them with a partner at your audition. You won't need to prepare a monologue this year. And if you'd also like to work backstage, just tell us when you come in; there's no separate sign-up.
items.prompt: [Announcement — Student theatre club] When are the chorus auditions for the spring musical?

"On Friday at 7:30 p.m." and "On Saturday at 4 p.m." each mix the chorus's day or time with the leads'.
